summary: Polars implementation of the relation system: the eight Substrait-aligned operation mixins plus Mountainash extension ops (distinct, drop_nulls, explode, sample, pivot, unpivot, top_k, join_asof, etc.) composed into PolarsRelationSystem. base.py adds backend identity, Arrow export/import and native-scan eligibility for resources.
key_classes: PolarsRelationSystem — registered (POLARS) relation system composing the base mixin, eight Substrait-aligned mixins (read, project, filter, sort, fetch, join, aggregate, set) and the Mountainash extension mixin by multiple inheritance
PolarsBaseRelationSystem — identifies the backend, supplies export/import_into/check_import and name-inference hooks
key_functions: register_relation_system(CONST_BACKEND.POLARS) — decorator in the package __init__ registering the composed class
declare_lowering(method[, LoweringDescriptor]) — module-level loop declaring every lowering method reusable; pivot declared REPEATABLE with materializes_input=True
extension_points: Subclass/compose a Substrait*/Mountainash* mixin and add it to the composed class bases
BaseRelationSystem hooks: infer_row_index_names, infer_cross_join_names, export, import_into, check_import, native_scan_eligible
lifecycle_notes: Latest change: 08ac43e6 feat(resources): confine native and fallback resource reads; decision-7 allow-list (381)
3b4cc887 lazy check_import payload so non-SQLite destinations never export
documentation_hooks: Backend implementation guide: adding a relation operation to a backend
Execution locations and Arrow import/export boundary
examples: Dispatched via the relation visitor: ma.relation(df).filter(...).collect() routes to the registered system for the frame's backend
risks: Lazy vs eager form is chosen from ExecutionLocation.form in import_into; export collects LazyFrames to Arrow
Row-index naming differs across backends (Polars prepends, Ibis appends), encoded in infer_row_index_names

evidence.detail: @register_relation_system(CONST_BACKEND.POLARS) on PolarsRelationSystem composed from Substrait and extension mixins
three-layer-separation and backend-composition principles: backends compose protocol implementations via multiple inheritance
